html:
Retest 27 Oct 2026 — the five fixes PASS; moved to Bug (QA decision): the items listed under "Limited", "Not tested" and "Not covered" are not verified yet
Environment: staging-desk.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, Edge (headless) + API; accounts: Desk Administrator (mahmoud.mahamed1515), Desk Agent (fedelav803) to read team tickets
Method: every item used on a QA ticket (rules guarded by Subject starts with "QA WF <id> ") and checked on the ticket, in Execution History and in Ticket History. Replies came from two real Gmail mailboxes.

Developer's comment (27 Oct) checked: all five fixes work on staging; the On Edit explanation holds; the not-testable list matches staging setup.

Fixes — all PASS:

  • A4 Private Thread: the trigger offers Incoming and outgoing / Incoming / Outgoing. Forward from #592 to a Gmail address (not the contact) → Outgoing and Both fired, Incoming did not. The answer from that address → filed as a private thread, Incoming and Both fired, Outgoing did not; the ticket stayed Open and Customer Responded was not set.
  • D1 Assign to a team, Create rule: tickets created by API (#605), by the New Ticket form (#616, #617) and by an agent with themself as owner (#618) all got team Customer Experience Specialists with the owner cleared; #618 was then assigned by the team round robin. Edit rule unchanged (#650: team set, owner cleared).
  • Is Overdue in Create rules: due date yesterday → "Is Overdue = true" fired, "= false" did not; due in 5 days → the opposite.
  • Ticket History: changes made by a rule read "by workflow rule <name>" (Share ticket, Add comment, Mark as spam, Reply sent), and the "Workflow rule ran" row shows the action as words ("Share ticket"). Same in Arabic ("بواسطة قاعدة سير العمل QA WF B07", "مشاركة التذكرة").
  • Email with a Desk template: a rule and a saved action with a template and no subject or body save and send (contact emailed, agent emailed; #612, #615). Without a template, subject and body are still required.

Developer's "not a bug" notes:

  • On Edit rule on a new ticket: confirmed — a new ticket did not run the On Edit rule within 20 s; a real edit ran it.
  • Untrusted replies not starting rules: accepted as designed, not retested this round. A1 was tested with a trusted Gmail reply.

Other items — PASS (used on QA tickets):

  • A1 Customer Reply (#648, trusted Gmail reply → rule fired, Customer Responded true); A2 Agent Response; A3 Comment with the "public" filter (private comment did not fire, public did).
  • B1 Add Comment (public / private), B2 Send Email Reply, B5 Add Followers, B6 Mark as Spam, B7 Share Ticket, B8 Change Layout, B11 Add Skills, B12 Remove Skills, Update Related Record.
  • D2 Email alerts to a user and the contact; D3 three watched fields (a fourth is refused); D4 All (2 of 3 changed → no run, 3 of 3 → run) and Any.
  • E1 Contact · Title and Account · Account Name; E2 during business hours; E3 Is Overdue and Created By; E4 doesn't contain; E5 between / not between; E6 Current Time — each with a matching and a non-matching ticket.
  • F1 saved Add comment and saved Email used by rules; F2 HR-only rule ran on an HR ticket, not on Customer Support; F3 Active / Inactive tabs (All 32 / Active 31 / Inactive 1); F4 as above.

Limited on staging (ran, result not provable):

  • B13 Recalculate Skills: Succeeded, changed false — no skill on staging has criteria.
  • B14 Reassign based on Skills: Succeeded, reassigned false, reason nobody_online.

Not tested (staging setup, as the developer noted):

  • A5 Happiness Rating (Customer Happiness disabled), B3 / B4 Instant Messaging (no WhatsApp brand), B10 Slack / Teams / Google Chat (none connected).
  • B9 Run Custom Action: not re-run — no custom action exists on staging now (tracked in NDC-1989).

Not covered in this round (no failure seen, not exercised):

  • A3 "private" and "any" comment filters.
  • D1 load balancing (only round robin seen).
  • D2 delivery to Team and Role (with subordinates) recipients — accepted on save only.
  • E1 Contact / Account fields as placeholders.
  • E2 outside business hours / on a holiday / not on a holiday as matching cases (staging is 24/7, no holiday).
  • E3 the other 22 new ticket fields used in a rule (they are offered in the field picker).
  • F1 saving each of the other new action types.
  • F2 department picker and D3 "+ Add a field" in the rule editor (checked through the API).

Also seen (outside this list — re-checked with controls, can be tracked separately):

  • False "Permission denied." after a successful save: New Ticket form, Customer Support, with an active Create rule "Assign to team Customer Experience Specialists" → Save shows the toast "Permission denied." (403) and the form stays open, but the ticket IS created once (#658, team set, no owner — seen by a team agent). Same form without the rule → saved and opened (#657). Same on API create (#605) and on an Edit rule (#650: edit saved, 403 returned). Cause seems to be the saver losing access after the rule moves the ticket. Users will submit again → duplicates.
  • "Workflow rule ran" History row missing for some conditions: five Create rules, same action, differing only in the condition (waited 60 s). No condition (#651), description contains (#652), Due Date before now (#655) → row written. Is Overdue = true (#653) and Execution Time = business hours (#654) → the rule runs (Execution History Fired, comment "by workflow rule …") but no "Workflow rule ran" row.
  • Filed as NDC-2660 — History row written at ticket create shows raw values: "Department changed · Field department_id · Old blank · New 7e1ac409-58b0-41ab-97e1-0e7d5c8c5158 · by System" (EN and AR). A later move shows names correctly ("Customer Support → HR", #656).

Evidence: NDC-2203-retest-r7.png (attached)
